correctness.rationale: Exact orthonormal-basis action and coefficient-ratio limits were reconstructed; coprimality forces finite directed paths, and specific degree-(L+1) reducing blocks have uniformly asymptotic edge weights. Adjoint normalized path vectors supply weakly null approximate eigenvectors at all |lambda|≤rho, excluding Fredholmness. A finite-head/small-norm-tail decomposition proves the exterior resolvent. Eigenvalues, fine spectrum, and essential norm follow from orthogonal path blocks and weakly null basis vectors. The standalone checker passed 9096 exact finite assertions, but no infinite theorem relies on finite testing.

value.rationale: The complete spectrum, Fredholm essential spectrum, point/continuous spectrum and exact essential norm are natural invariants for nonnormal composition-adjoint products studied in recent Schatten-class literature. Despite every nonconstant reducing block being nilpotent, arbitrarily long blocks produce a full spectral disk. The regular-variation exponent yields a sharp three-way classification of the location of the constant eigenvalue across weighted Bergman, Hardy and Dirichlet scales. This is an all-degree/all-coefficient-family structural statement, not a numerical slice, normalization identity or a single finite experiment.
